title: A Group-Specific Approach to NLP for Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates antisemitic hate speech detection by infusing a custom knowledge graph (KnowledJe) containing historical and linguistic context into tweets from the Echo Corpus, testing performance using Logistic Regression and DistilBERT classifiers. Additionally, it proposes a scorecard of 14 specific stereotypes to assess latent antisemitism in language models.
